items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was dedicated to Liz, wasn't it? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah...

ctx.x: Man. But again, nobody ever came up to me and said, "Man, that was really nice." I said it on the record, at the end of the record, if you let it play long enough, and you have the volume up, you'll see...I say, "Man, that's a bitch." That's on that record, you know, way...before it reject. If you just let it play that part before it reject you'll hear that. See..oh, that was something.
That was dedicated to Liz, wasn't it?
